story.text: Marley was dead, to begin with. His old partner, Ebenezer Scrooge, is a {SQUEEZING}, grasping, {COVETOUS} old sinner. When his nephew Fred wishes him a merry {CHRISTMAS}, Scrooge answers: “Bah! {HUMBUG}!” And when two portly gentlemen ask him to give something to the poor, he only asks: are there no prisons? Are there no {WORKHOUSES}?
story.caption: They were portly gentlemen, pleasant to behold
